evidence_items.text: - On 2023-10-08, when telling Calvin about his car show and restored/modified car (details in ## Classic cars), said working on cars "is not just a hobby, it's a passion" — it's "like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress"; as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage, tinkering with engines — "it was like my own sanctuary" (echoing his childhood memories of working on cars with his dad, see above); now he's "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome" [S22T5].

- On 2023-08-03, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see!"): Calvin told him his recent Ferrari service was so stressful (he's attached to the car) and asked what kind of hobbies give Dave a feeling of being restored; Dave said fixing cars is like therapy for him — growing up working on cars with his dad, refurbishing gives fulfillment — and shared his fond childhood memory of spending a summer with his dad restoring an old car (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S12T1][S12T2][S12T4].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave shared a childhood photo of himself and his dad (a man and a child posing) from that car-restoring summer, and Calvin found it cool ("Reminiscing is always fun!"); Calvin then shared a photo of his red Ferrari on a lift in a garage, saying his car is the best and "reminds me of my hard work and dedication"; Dave said the car looks great, "I can tell why you're proud," and "it's like a reminder of what you can achieve" (details of Calvin's car in /memories/calvin.md > ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26)) [S12T5][S12T6][S12T7][S12T8].
